verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation on Fly.io's private networking, organizations, or app-level network segmentation that would let a devops-lead isolate staging/dev apps from production services; the closest items (fly-io-docs-11/12/13) describe per-Sprite credential/service access for AI-agent sandboxes, not traditional environment isolation for production apps. Missing for 10: docs on Fly private 6PN networks, org/app-level firewall or network policies, and any explicit guidance on separating non-prod from prod traffic.
